messages:
jordan: Anyone else seeing truncated SSE payloads for streaming responses? Console shows connection lingered ~4s then 'transport closed' but last token chunk missing.

mira: details? env / route / model?

jordan: prod, route /v1/streams, model gpt-rlhf-XL. Using chunked transfer. Sample headers/log below:
```
GET /v1/streams HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.com
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Connection: keep-alive
X-Request-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d
```
Log snippet: 
```
[stream] send chunk len=512
[stream] send chunk len=128
[edge] tcp FIN/RST observed from client after 3.9s linger
[stream] flush incomplete, close transport
```
Client shows final tokens missing.

sachin: Could be proxy keepalive closing mid-chunk or our flush path. Which edge/proxy stack?

jordan: opaque-proxy (our edge) -> GCLB. We recently rolled streaming-handler v3.4.2 to canary this morning.

ops-bot: deployed 2950001200: rolling canary update streaming-handler v3.4.2 (canary 10%) :rocket:

sachin: That deploy touched response flushing & chunk boundary logic. Can we rollback canary quickly?

jordan: I removed the canary from one shard. Repro still happens on older instances though, so not purely the new code. Timing looks racy: when client issues TCP RST during final chunk, server closes before trailing CRLF is written -> client-side chunk parser drops final chunk.

mira: This explains the console message confusion. We show 'stream ended' generic badge. We should surface 'truncated' vs 'graceful' so customers see bad output. :eyes:

alex: Telemetry is weak here — stream_end_reason currently 'closed'. We need an enum like ['graceful', 'idle_timeout', 'client_reset', 'protocol_error'] and record last_chunk_bytes. Also record which proxy (edge vs gclb) observed RST.

samira: I'll create an issue and add to Console Rollouts board for UX change + new telemetry. Can we add a quick feature flag to show 'truncated' in the console for affected requests?

jordan: I'll upload pcap and full logs to #incidents/rq_0a1b2c3d. For immediate mitigation we can: 1) ensure server does an explicit flush+linger before close, or 2) have edge retry transparent fallback to non-chunked framing for the final write. Leaning to (1) as quick fix.

sachin: (1) sounds safer. But need to verify it won't increase socket linger and backpressure. Add a bounded linger window (e.g., 50-200ms) and metric 'linger_millis' to monitor.

mira: Also UX: show small tooltip explaining 'truncated' and include link to rollout notes and telemetry query. Samira, please coordinate copy.

samira: Will do. I'll attach proposed copy in the issue.

jordan: Thanks. I'll triage and leave notes in the incident thread. If anyone else repros, drop request ids here.

alex: One more ask: add a Console filter for 'truncated streams' so support can quickly surface impacted customers.

jordan: +1. I'll follow up with a short PR for the telemetry enum.

samira: tagging @mira @sachin for review on the issue. :thumbsup:

(ended)
